Raghav Chadha Meets PM Modi Amidst Punjab Election Speculation

Aam Aadmi Party MP Raghav Chadha met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi. Chadha described the meeting as "a morning to cherish" and shared photos of the interaction. The meeting occurred during the ongoing Monsoon Session of Parliament. Several reports suggest the discussion may have involved Chadha's potential role in Punjab politics, particularly concerning the 2027 state assembly elections. Separately, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath also met with PM Modi in Delhi, with speculation surrounding discussions about the 2027 UP elections.
